name: download_vnp46a1_official_h5
purpose: Run official NASA Earthdata VNP46A1 HDF5 download and clipped daily radiance mosaics for one ISO3 country or WGS84 bounding box, optionally with UTC_Time companion rasters.
side_effects: creates target geometry, run manifests, HDF5 files, radiance mosaics, optional UTC_Time mosaics, and audit files under output_root

name: validate_download_environment
purpose: Inspect local GEE/Earthdata download readiness without exposing credentials.

name: download_gee_raster
purpose: Export a validated Earth Engine Image or ImageCollection reduction as a single- or multi-band GeoTIFF, with controlled optical/QA/index preprocessing presets.
side_effects: creates a new GeoTIFF and a suffixed name when necessary

name: submit_gee_batch_export
purpose: Submit a validated large GEE raster export to Drive, Cloud Storage, or an Earth Engine asset and persist a recoverable task manifest.
side_effects: creates a remote Earth Engine batch task and a local ntl.gee.export.v1 manifest

name: inspect_gee_batch_export
purpose: Refresh live progress, terminal state, and failure details for a submitted Earth Engine export.
side_effects: updates status history in the existing local export manifest

name: cancel_gee_batch_export
purpose: Request cancellation for a non-terminal Earth Engine export while retaining its manifest history.
side_effects: may cancel a remote Earth Engine task and updates its local export manifest

name: download_vnp46a2_official_h5_country
purpose: Run official NASA Earthdata VNP46A2 HDF5 country mosaics and audit output coverage.
side_effects: creates run manifests, HDF5 files, mosaics, and audit files under output_root

name: inspect_download_run
purpose: Read VNP46A1 or VNP46A2 runtime state during an active download, or a completed audit with exact retry/mosaic targets.
